description: Topics for the weekly state-of-the-art watch (tooling/sota_watch.py, run by .github/workflows/sota-watch.yml; issue #292). Each topic has an arXiv API search query (syntax: https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html) and names what in this repository a new paper on it could change, so a person knows which claim to re-check. The watch lists candidates in one issue titled 'SOTA watch' and never edits anything. Papers already in knowledge/data/frontier_results.json are not listed again. A path marked planned does not exist yet; tooling/test_sota_watch.py fails once it does, so the mark comes off.

topics.title: Magic state cultivation and factories
topics.query: abs:"magic state cultivation" OR abs:"magic state distillation" OR abs:"magic state factory" OR abs:"magic state injection" OR abs:"magic state preparation" OR abs:"T factory" OR abs:"T state" OR abs:"CCZ factory" OR abs:"CCZ state"

bears_on.check: the share of physical qubits the estimates give to T factories, which comes from a distillation factory model
the magic-state factory model the resource estimates are built with
what its notes say fault-tolerant computation needs

topics.title: RSA and ECDLP resource estimates
topics.query: (abs:RSA OR abs:ECDLP OR abs:"elliptic curve" OR abs:"discrete logarithm" OR abs:"integer factoring" OR abs:"integer factorization" OR abs:"Shor's algorithm") AND (abs:qubit OR abs:Toffoli OR abs:"resource estimate")

bears_on.check: the logical-qubit figure for RSA-2048 in its notes
what its notes say about breaking elliptic-curve cryptography

topics.title: Decoded quantum interferometry
topics.query: abs:"decoded quantum interferometry" OR (abs:DQI AND cat:quant-ph)

bears_on.check: the speedup its notes describe and the reference behind it

topics.title: FeMoco and iron-sulfur cluster resource estimates
topics.query: (abs:FeMoco OR abs:"FeMo-co" OR abs:nitrogenase OR abs:"iron-sulfur" OR abs:Fe2S2 OR abs:Fe4S4) AND (abs:qubit OR abs:"quantum computer" OR abs:"quantum computing" OR abs:"quantum algorithm" OR abs:"fault-tolerant")

bears_on.check: the fairness review against the best-known classical baseline
the markers that classify FeMoco and iron-sulfur clusters as targets for quantum computation

topics.title: Lattice gauge theory resource estimates
topics.query: (abs:"lattice gauge" OR abs:"gauge theory" OR abs:"lattice QCD") AND (abs:qubit OR abs:"quantum computer" OR abs:"quantum simulation")

bears_on.check: the residual risks for real-time dynamics
the utility case its notes make

topics.title: LLM- or evaluator-guided circuit discovery
topics.query: (abs:"large language model" OR abs:LLM OR abs:AlphaEvolve OR abs:OpenEvolve OR abs:FunSearch) AND (abs:"quantum circuit" OR abs:"quantum algorithm" OR abs:"quantum computation" OR abs:"quantum program")
